gaps.text: Workspace/follow baseline must decode the 0.1.2 nested value shape and never silently wipe workspaces
gaps.details: Evidence: main's WorkspaceFollowFrame.Baseline decodes flat top-level keys (core SessionHistoryDtos.kt:370-375) while the sibling session-control baseline in the same file nests under value (:278-280); with ignoreUnknownKeys (JsonRpc.kt:19-20) a 0.1.2 host's {type:baseline, value:{items, archivedSessionIds}} decodes to empty and SessionStore.kt:776-783 then clears all workspaces on every connect. A tested fast-forwardable fix exists unlanded on branch fix/workspace-baseline-nested-value (commit eb84328, +13 code +34 test WorkspaceFollowBaselineTest.kt). Mock-harness implements no workspace/follow baseline, so the gate pins neither shape. Done: nested decode landed on main (merge eb84328 or equivalent), round-trip pin test green in the CI gate, and mock-harness serves a baseline fixture so the shape stays pinned.

gaps.text: 0.1.2 protocol migration verified against a real harness and device, not only mock replay
gaps.details: Evidence: 286f26e commit body - "Not yet verified against a real 0.1.2 harness or a device; tools/capture is re-pointed for that"; no in-repo record the capture run happened. Upstream has since moved to dsh-v0.1.7-rc.1 tags, so unverifiable drift is growing. App-side conformance is only evidenced by its own test suite + CHANGELOG narrative. Done: a capture from a live 0.1.2 host replayed as a golden test, or a documented manual verification note (docs/ or CHANGELOG) naming harness version, device, and date.

gaps.text: Pairing regression class (latched 401 signal) covered by a real test
gaps.details: Evidence: 391f4f9 commit body - the Sign-in reopen bug was "not covered by a test - PairViewModel needs five injected dependencies including an Android Context, and this module has no mocking or Robolectric dependency". Nothing added since. Done: a unit test in :app's gate that constructs PairViewModel (Robolectric or injected fakes) and fails on the latched-signal bug class.

gaps.text: Security docs describe the current 0.1.2 token-auth posture instead of the pre-0.1.2 loopback-only one
gaps.details: Evidence: harness/README.md:3-4 "no authentication of any kind" and :182-184 "stay loopback-only by design" contradict the shipped 0.1.2 launch-token flow (HarnessSessionStore.kt:21-56 token-to-cookie exchange, connect_mode_lan_hint strings.xml:391, COMPATIBILITY.md:118-156). docs/SECURITY.md:23 "There are no tokens, cookies, or TLS" is stale, and its promised banner (:34-35) is the dead string connect_security_banner (strings.xml:54, zero Kotlin refs; ConnectScreen.kt:141 uses connect_mode_lan_hint). SettingsScreen.kt:185-188 also renders settings_readonly_banner unconditionally although post-0.1.2 authenticated callers reach the full API. Done: harness/README + SECURITY.md LAN sections rewritten to the token posture, dead banner string removed, settings banner conditional or removed, gate green.
